label: Carousel guide
title: Five rules for a carousel people finish
text: One grid, one idea per slide, and a question that earns the next swipe.

label: Grid
title: Every slide shares one grid
text: Label and counter on top, then the title, content that fills the height, and a footer.
next: So where does the logo go?

label: Brand
title: The logo stays small until the end
text: A small mark on the cover, the full logo on the closer, and nothing in between.

label: Words
title: Fifteen to twenty words per slide
text: Name the topic, make one point, and cut every word that repeats the title.

label: Pull
title: End on the question the next slide answers
text: Curiosity carries the swipe. Only the cover asks for it out loud.

title: Save this for your next carousel
text: One template, six slides, one command.
